title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W3 stale-bounce gate compares mismatched timestamp formats — a same-day redelivered pre-correction failure still exhausts the corrected row and fabricates referee_contact_invalid
detail: attempts 'at' is Gleam RFC3339 ('2026-08-01T08:00:00.123456Z', T-separator) but corrected_at::text is Postgres timestamptz ('2026-08-01 10:00:00+00', space-separated). Lexicographic compare across the formats is not chronological: 'T'(0x54) > ' '(0x20), so ANY same-calendar-date pair yields at > corrected regardless of actual time — a stale pre-correction bounce redelivered the same day as the correction exhausts and stamps referee_contact_invalid. The W3 test only pins the cross-day case (hardcoded 2026-08-01 vs now()).
recommended_fix: Normalize both instants to one format (e.g. compare epoch millis in Gleam, or return corrected_at as to_char(...,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') in SQL). Add a same-day stale-redelivery test.

title: Correction re-invite leaks the previous referee's draft answers and form-opened state to the corrected referee
evidence: correct_reference_call.sql SET list: "corrected_name = NULLIF($3, ''), corrected_email = NULLIF($4, ''), corrected_phone = NULLIF($5, ''), correction_cycles = correction_cycles + 1, corrected_at = now(), terminal_reason = NULL, attempt_count = 0, form_token = NULL, form_token_expires_at = NULL, next_attempt_at = now(), updated_at = now()" — form_handler.gleam:162: "let draft = questions.decode_draft(row.draft_answers)" and :233-235: "let prefill = case prefill_override { Some(#(id, fields)) if id == q.id -> fields _ -> questions.prefill_for(q:, draft:) }" — questions.gleam:628-629: "Rebuild a question's raw form fields from the draft (revisit pre-fill)."
detail: Wrong-person → awaiting_correction keeps draft_answers/form_opened_at; the landlord's correct re-queues without clearing them; the sweep mints a fresh token and the corrected referee's form pre-fills the previous referee's partial answers (cross-subject exposure, and answer contamination defeating referee independence).
recommended_fix: Clear draft_answers and form_opened_at in correct_reference_call.sql (and the wrong-person awaiting transition); pin with an integration test asserting the re-invited form renders no prefill.
